description: Abstract class 'Activity' defining workflow activity behaviors, properties, and lifecycle methods within OrchardCore workflows.

classes.name: Activity
classes.description: Abstract base class for workflow activities, providing default implementations and utility methods.

methods.name: GetPossibleOutcomesAsync
methods.description: Asynchronously retrieves possible outcomes for the activity.

methods.name: CanExecuteAsync
methods.description: Checks asynchronously if the activity can execute.

methods.name: CanExecute
methods.description: Checks synchronously if the activity can execute.

methods.name: Outcome
methods.description: Creates an Outcome object with a localized name.

methods.name: Outcomes
methods.description: Creates multiple Outcome objects from localized strings or strings.

methods.name: Outcomes
methods.description: Creates multiple Outcome objects from string names.

methods.name: Halt
methods.description: Returns an ActivityExecutionResult indicating halted state.

methods.name: GetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property value with optional default, using caller member name.

methods.name: GetProperty
methods.description: Retrieves a property value with specified type and optional default.

methods.name: SetProperty
methods.description: Sets a property value, cloning if it's a JsonNode.
